items.title: Goated Teens
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These are the greatest city teens characters of all time! 
* 21 HD skins!

items.title: Adorable Kittens
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These teen cats are the cutest characters ever and are ready for role-playing and adventure!
* 32 PURRRfect skins!
* Hide your catnip!

items.title: Space Animals
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you ready for an out of this world skin pack? Roleplay as a space animal and you to can go to the moon!

+ 11 space animals!
+ By Nitirc Concepts

items.title: Snack TIme
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as a hot dog, or a slice of pizza! Loads of quirky fun await you!

+ 10 snack time skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Alien Mobs
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Out in the furthest reaches of the infinite world, life is beginning for these alien mob friends!

items.title: Skull Teens
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Woah, spooky! These teens are dressed up in bright neon gear and are all wearing skull masks! I wonder what they're up to?

- 8 intense skeleton-themed skins!
- Wide variety of colors and styles, find the perfect skin that suits you!

items.title: Power Armor
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Gear up with the latest in power armor technologies! With brightly colored wires and chipboards underneath the armor, you will be sure to catch everyone's attention!

- 8 unique skins!
- With so many colors and designs, you can pick the perfect skin that suits you!

items.title: Vibrant Teens
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Be the trendiest and most vibrant teen in the neighborhood! Check out these 20 awesome skins--each with a unique colorful style that will make you stand out from the rest!

items.title: Speedrunner
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Run, jump, and parkour your way through 8 speedrun courses! Each course is full of traps and powerups. Dodge spikes and avoid poisonous mushrooms while competing for the best time. Go fast or be consumed by trailing lava.
- 8 replayable levels
- 8 collectible trophies
- 17 traps and powerups
- 5 skins
- Multiplayer fun

Share your fastest speedrun times with your friends!

items.title: Deserts+
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Explore a newly improved biome, featuring one of the lushest deserts ever seen in Minecraft! 

New additions:
- Tree type: Palm
- Cactus type: Branching
- 12 blocks: 3 palm blocks, 2 stripped blocks, 5 cacti, and 2 coconuts
- Animal mobs: Meerkats, scorpions, and camels
- 8 potions
- 6 items
- No reskins, all additions are new

Warning: Don't pet scorpions!

items.title: Creeper Island
items.creator: Enchanted
items.description:
Evolved creepers inhabit Creeper Island. Changing colors to confuse travelers, they now await new arrivals to their shore. Attempt to climb the mountain that touches the sky and gain epic rewards. Do you have what it takes to conquer the island and take the loot that they protect?
- Unique terrain to explore
- 1 free skin
- By Enchanted

items.title: BEE
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
BEE has some of the best modern teen fashion. Every outfit is themed like a bee!

+ Modern teen clothing
+ Great for anyone who loves bee fashion

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: PrestonPlayz Secret Impostors
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
There seems to be an impostor among us! Is Preston suspicious? Check out these 18 variety skins from bunny, cyborg, demon, and police. Perfect for your next space adventure!

- 1 Preston skin
- 18 total skins

By PrestonPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: Mega Block Parkour 2
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description: Parkour through the sky in Mega Block Parkour 2! There are 10 giant block-themed parkour levels.

items.title: Party Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The coolest party has just started, and people are already on the dance floor! Choose from 12 stylish skins and join in on the fun! 

+ 12 beautiful skins!
+ Perfect for role-playing!
+ By Street Studios

items.title: Skyblock Fashion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Are you looking for the amazing skin pack for your new skyblock adventure? Skyblock Fashion is perfect for you! Explore new islands with a pack of fashionably dressed teens!

- 10 skins perfect for skyblock roleplay 
- Fashionable outfits
- By CribSon

items.title: Floral Demons
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Demons aren't just scary! These cute and colorful demons have spent a lot of time in the garden picking out their favorite flowers. Take a stroll through the city or make your friends at school jealous with these perfect skins!

- Modern designs for teens
- Floral demon skins
- Perfect for roleplay
- Cute, cool, and colorful

items.title: Mystery Hunters
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Mysteries are fun to seek out in style! Find a buddy to tag along with on your adventure to seek out the mysteries of the world!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Inspired by modern and casual attire

items.title: How to Train Your Dragon
items.creator: Gamemode One
items.description:
This is Berk, home of Vikings and dragons! Join Toothless, Hiccup, and the rest of the dragons and riders on heroic adventures in Minecraft. Compete in racing, map the world, and release captive dragons from invading trappers! Tame, collect, and train dragons from the vast reaches of the Barbaric Archipelago to become an expert dragon rider. 
Includes original skins!

items.title: Trendy School Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
It is time for you to shine within the game with a brand new outstanding skin pack. Let your character be a trendy teen with a modern fashion look!

+ Anime appearance
+ Teen fashion
+ 2 free skins
+ By In Mine

items.title: Soft Grunge Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Soft grunge is a fashion trend that originated in 2010 as a form of 1990s appropriation. Reimagined with modern e-styles, this skin pack is a perfect choice for fashionable teens with good taste as this style combines old school parts with a new school's attitude.

+ Anime
+ Teens fashion
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Dirt Mansion
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Have you always been a dirt fan? Imagine a mansion fully made out of dirt! Even the furniture is dirt! And what about the vehicles? The helicopter and the 2 cars are also made of dirt! Everything is dirt! Everywhere you look is dirt!

+Furniture!
+Dirt house!
+Dirt helicopter & cars!

items.title: Anime Popstars
items.creator: Black Arts Studios
items.description:
The spotlight is on you, it's your time to shine! Show your passion for music by becoming the next popstar with these 14 skins!

-Includes 14 anime skins
-By: Black Arts Studios

items.title: Swag Mobs
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
What’s the coolest Minecraft mob? Creatures from all the realms have come out in mass to prove once and for all who is the best! From red hot Blazes and super cool Guardians to the charming chaos of the Endermen. Decide for yourself which wins out, and find the perfect fit with the Swag Mobs skin pack! 

~Cute mob themed skins
~Fun for any roleplay
